passage: A quick reminder about checking returned tablets. Peel off the shipping film from the little sensor window beside the camera, and turn on automatic brightness. Then take the tablet from the bright bench to the dark test box. If the display is equally bright in both places, note a possible sensor fault. Don’t use that label just because the display is brighter than you want. The tablet on my tray arrived with its film removed and automatic brightness on. It dimmed inside the box, just not enough. List that as a brightness setting issue.
